title: Tuples & zip
hints: README 'New syntax': every answer is one Prelude function (zip, zipWith, lookup, unzip), sometimes plus `sum`.
pairUp is zip. dotProduct: multiply pairwise, then add up. indexed: zip an infinite range starting at 1 with the list. ageOf: look the name up. splitPairs: undo a zip.
`dotProduct xs ys = sum (zipWith (*) xs ys)` · `indexed xs = zip [1 ..] xs` · `splitPairs pairs = unzip pairs`.
